audience: public sale, self-signup, 10+ unknown PRIVATE schools first (D43); R1 = first MILESTONE, the public launch is the COMPLETE plan (D45); government/MPO institutions stay in the plan as OPTIONAL, lower priority, hidden by default (D44)

step_scope_notes.3.6: UI Pack runtime Phase A only (classic pack). Kept because pages written without PageSlot are expensive to retrofit.
step_scope_notes.3.7: i18n infrastructure (bn + en) only. No Arabic content, no RTL snapshots (logical Tailwind classes are still mandatory).
step_scope_notes.3.8: Smoke subset: F1 login, F2 enrol->fee->receipt->parent, F5 language toggle. Not the 12-combination matrix.
step_scope_notes.4.4: Fee categories, structures, collection, receipts, dues. NOT: expenses, installments, waivers, online payment, refunds, cash book.
step_scope_notes.4.5: Exams, marks entry, grading, marksheet PDF. NOT: admit card, merit list, weighted result sheets, due-blocking. Parents read results via /parent/children/{id}/results and the marksheet via /results/marksheet/{studentId} (admin, teacher, parent of the child, student) - published exams only.
step_scope_notes.4.6: SMS (absence alert after attendance is saved, receipt SMS after a payment), credits, SMS log + balance view (GET /sms-logs, GET /subscription/sms-credits), platform sender with institution suffix. NOT: notices, bulk fee-due reminders (R1.1), templates/campaigns/emergency (R2), the institution's own sender-ID approval flow (R2).
step_scope_notes.4.7: Admin, teacher, accountant, PARENT panels. NOT: student login.
step_scope_notes.4.8: Receipt, marksheet, due list, attendance report, class list. NOT: ID cards, certificates.
step_scope_notes.5.1: Self-signup + onboarding wizard. SIGNUP_MODE=invite|open (env) so the public switch can be flipped without code.
step_scope_notes.5.2: Plans, trial, grace, suspend, invoices, SSLCommerz subscription payment, SMS-credit purchase. Tax/VAT parameter fixed at 0 until OD-4.
step_scope_notes.5.3: Super Admin: institutions, plans, payments, SMS credits and sender status. NOT: support tickets, coupons, impersonation.
step_scope_notes.4.2: Students, enrollment, student-ID, Excel import of students. The import API (/imports) lives in module data_migration, which IS in release.modules for R1 but restricted by config('release.import_kinds') = ['students']; other kinds (teachers, fee_history, results, attendance) are R1.1. The OLD /students/import/* endpoints of student-import.md are SUPERSEDED (that document remains the row-validation and template-column spec).
step_scope_notes.4.3: Daily attendance, holidays, absence SMS. Parents read via /parent/children/{id}/attendance.

R1.1: fee due reminders (bulk SMS to parents of students with dues)

route_exclude.why: seat plan and merit list are R1.1+
ID card, TC/transfer and promotion are later modules
theme editor is R2; R1 has logo and brand colour only

extra_tasks.title: Walking-skeleton Spike and Gate (D28)
extra_tasks.goal: Prove the architecture end to end on a thin slice BEFORE building the rest; measure; the owner signs the Gate.
extra_tasks.scope: S0-S8 incl. S5b/S5c/S5d. Run mysql-smoke.sh (exit must be 0) and perf-check.py first (SPIKE-RUNBOOK step 0, S1b).
extra_tasks.done: Gate recorded and signed in docs/SPIKE-LOG.md. If the Gate says Adjust/Stop, STOP and return to the owner - do not start Phase 3.

extra_tasks.title: Privacy and children's data (D27)
extra_tasks.goal: Make the product lawful and safe to open to strangers' schools.
extra_tasks.scope: StudentErasureService (one deleteDirectory under institutions/{id}/students/{sid}/ + rows); tenant:purge; sms:trim and audit:trim retention (NOT leads:purge, tenants:purge-due, devices:prune, risk:prune - those modules are later); /privacy and /terms pages (text supplied by the owner's lawyer); INCIDENT-RUNBOOK.md; the restore drill.
extra_tasks.done: ErasureRemovesAllStudentFilesTest, TenantPurgeFilesTest, RetentionPurgeTest green; privacy/terms pages render from the owner-supplied text.

extra_tasks.title: Security hardening
extra_tasks.goal: Close the security checklist before strangers use it.
extra_tasks.scope: Every item of the checklist; permission matrix (SECURITY.md) vs RoleMatrixContractTest; token lifetimes per role (D26); rate limits; cross-tenant tests for EVERY R1 route (CrossTenantRouteTest).
extra_tasks.done: Checklist ticked with evidence in docs/PROGRESS.md; RouteMiddlewareContractTest, CrossTenantRouteTest, RoleMatrixContractTest green.

extra_tasks.title: Load and scale test (before SIGNUP_MODE=open)
extra_tasks.goal: Know the peak-hour behaviour before strangers arrive.
extra_tasks.scope: perf-check.py at SCALE=1 on target-like hardware; then the k6 peak-hour profile against a disposable database.
extra_tasks.done: No FULLSCAN/SORT/SLOW; p95 within the owner's limit at the measured peak; scaling triggers in performance-benchmarks.md replaced by measured numbers.

extra_tasks.title: Deployment, backup, monitoring
extra_tasks.goal: A production environment that survives a bad day.
extra_tasks.scope: Docker (staging), Nginx internal + Caddy edge, WILDCARD subdomain only (custom domain is R2: skip custom-domain.md Part C), CI/CD, MySQL backup + a rehearsed restore, slow-query log (long_query_time 0.5), queue-depth and error monitoring, FILES_DRIVER=s3 if more than one server.
extra_tasks.done: push to main runs tests, builds and deploys; a backup is restored on a clean machine and mysql-smoke.sh passes against it; alerts fire on a forced error.

extra_tasks.title: Release 1 acceptance, then open signup
extra_tasks.goal: Decide, with evidence, that strangers may sign up.
extra_tasks.scope: Tick every box in RELEASE-1.md section 7 with evidence; the non-code launch checklist (section 5); closed beta first: SIGNUP_MODE=invite.
extra_tasks.done: All boxes ticked; the owner flips SIGNUP_MODE=open (an owner decision, never the agent's).
